description.value: Tumbler Ridge Public Library is a community library located inside the TR Community Centre, serving both residents and all visitors to this small northeastern BC town. It offers free Wi-Fi and internet access along with a Telus 4G smart hub loan program for connectivity outside the building. Unique offerings like a seed library, STEAM kits, and a noise-dampening meeting pod make this a well-resourced small-town library well beyond the basics.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is active and matches OSM tags for phone, address, and URL. The services page explicitly confirms free Wi-Fi ('Bring your own device and access our Wi-Fi'), corroborated by OSM internet_access=wlan. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the site; the library is housed inside the TR Community Centre, which may have some of these facilities, but they are not confirmed in available evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The library offers confirmed free Wi-Fi and is open to all visitors including touring cyclists, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. The Community Centre building it occupies may provide these facilities, but a site visit or direct contact is needed to verify before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Library is physically located inside the TR Community Centre; washrooms and possible bike parking may be available via the broader facility but cannot be confirmed from website content alone.

provenance.category_correction_reason: A public library is more accurately a community service or rest stop than a tourism attraction; consider recategorizing if the directory has a 'Services' or 'Rest Stops' category.
